papers.title: Attention-Based Beamformer For Multi-Channel Speech Enhancement
source_facts: ABIC-MVDR estimates separate speech/noise instantaneous spatial covariance matrices and attention-weighted time-varying SCMs.
Page3Eq5 uses inverse noise SCM times speech SCM, normalized by trace and applied to a reference-channel selector; Eq6 filters the complex observed signal.
Target and background estimation are operational learned parts of the source system; this paper does not identify relational nuisance from text roles.
limits: No claim that the proposed Q-RMEA formula is identical to source Eq5.
No transfer of speech SNR gains or distortionless guarantee to classification.

papers.title: Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Metric Learning for Cross-Head Attention in Transformers
source_facts: DAMCHA defines a learned input-dependent cross-head metric, row-sums blocks, computes input-dependent bilinear scores and applies softmax (p4Eq4-8).
Its Mahalanobis-like matrix is explicitly not required positive definite (p2); do not silently interpret it as a covariance inverse.
Input-adaptive attention geometry already has a direct precursor; role-protected covariance filtering is not established by that general framing.
limits: Dimensions and global expressivity claims not independently certified.
PDF NeurIPS2026 header observed, venue acceptance not independently verified.

coverage: Two selected originals from three bounded arXiv queries. Not exhaustive novelty clearance; general web provider route404 recorded privately.
